components.note: 氵 (water radical, 三点水) — marks liquids and things that flow, as in 河 river, 汤 soup, 酒 liquor; here an oily liquid.
由 (yóu) sounds exactly like 油 — the same sound clue appears in 邮 yóu and 柚 yòu.
阝 (mound, left-side form of 阜 hill) — relates to hills, walls and places, as in 院 courtyard, 阳 sun-side, 陆 land; fits 际 as a boundary.
示 (shì) is only a loose sound hint — traditional 際 used 祭 (jì), and simplification swapped in 示.
并 (combine) — simplified from 並, which showed two figures standing side by side; hence together, also, and (并且).
穴 (cave, hole) — the radical of holes and hollow spaces, as in 空 empty, 窗 window, 穿 pierce.
犬 (dog) — a dog bursting out of its den 穴: the picture of something sudden and unexpected.
木 (wood) — 枪 first meant a wooden spear; wood radical also in 棍 stick and 板 board.
仓 (cāng) hints at the sound — close to qiāng; the same part is in 抢 qiǎng and 苍 cāng.
纟 (thread, simplified 糸) — silk and cord words: 红 red, 给 give, 线 line; a thread has an end, which fits 终 end.
冬 (dōng) rhymes with 终 zhōng, and 冬 originally meant the end (of the year) too — so it helps sound and sense.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions done by hand, as in 打 hit, 抱 hug, 拉 pull; fits 拥 to embrace or hold.
用 (yòng) is only a loose sound hint for yōng — same ending -ong.
氵 (water radical) — 派 first meant a stream branching off a river, which grew into branch, faction and to send out.
口 (mouth) — often added to characters that only imitate foreign sounds, as in 啡 and 吗.
加 (jiā) gives a rough sound for kā — 咖 only imitates the sound of "coffee" and has no meaning of its own.
口 (mouth) — marks a character used for a drinkable or spoken sound; here it only helps spell "coffee" (咖啡).
非 (fēi) sounds exactly like 啡; the same clue is in 菲 fēi and 匪 fěi.
阝 (mound, left-side form of 阜 hill) — a hill is an obstacle, which fits 阻 to block; compare 院 courtyard, 陆 land.
且 (qiě) gives only a loose hint, but 阻 sounds exactly like 祖 zǔ and 组 zǔ, which share the same 且 part.
止 (stop) — a picture of a foot planted on the ground: where the foot stops. Seen in 步 step (two feet) and 正 correct.
象 (elephant) — a picture of an elephant with trunk on top and legs below. 像 likeness adds 亻; 想象 imagine, 印象 impression use the "image" sense.
冫 (ice, 两点水) — cold and freezing: 冰 ice, 冻 freeze, 凉 cool; here simply cold.
令 (lìng) is a loose sound clue (l- start); it also sounds out 领 lǐng and 铃 líng.
青 (qīng) hints at the -ing rhyme; same part in 清 请 情 晴 精. The 争 (contend) half is not a reliable clue.
木 (wood) — 标 first meant the tip of a tree, hence a mark or target; wood radical as in 树 tree, 板 board.
票 (piào) is the sound in traditional 標; same series 漂 piāo and 飘 piāo; simplified 标 now shows 示.
米 (rice) — refined grain gives the idea of essence and the best part, hence 精 fine, spirit (精神).
青 (qīng) is a near sound match (-ing); the series 青 清 请 情 晴 静 helps recall jīng.
礻 (altar, spirit — form of 示) — gods, rites and blessings: 礼 ritual, 福 fortune, 祝 wish; here 神 god or spirit.
申 (shēn) gives the sound (shén, tone differs); also in 伸 shēn stretch and 绅 shēn.
木 (wood) — trees and wooden things: 树, 林, 桥; here a pine tree, the original meaning.
公 (gōng) is a loose sound clue for sōng; same series 颂 sòng, 翁 wēng.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 住, 做.
木 (tree) — a person 亻 leaning on a tree 木: resting, hence 休息 rest and 退休 retire.
⺮ (bamboo, 竹字头) — written things and bamboo goods: 笔 pen, 第 order, 筷 chopsticks; 答 comes from bamboo slips used for replies.
合 (hé, together) — matching an answer to a question; sound is only loose, but 合 also sounds out 搭 dā.
凶 (ominous) — an open pit 凵 with crossed marks inside: a trap, a sign of danger; seen in 凶手 murderer, 凶器 weapon.
手 (hand) — a picture of a hand with fingers spread. As a left-hand radical it becomes 扌 in 打 hit, 拿 take, 推 push.
贝 (cowry shell, money) — wealth and value: 财, 货, 买, 贵. 负 shows a person 人 carrying money: a burden, to bear or owe.
贝 (cowry shell, money) — 责 first meant demanding payment of a debt, hence duty. 责 sounds out 债 zhài, 积 jī and 绩 jì.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — talking and language: 说 say, 请 ask, 读 read; testing often involves questions.
式 (shì) sounds exactly like 试 — a reliable sound clue.
目 (eye) — eyes and seeing: 看 look, 眼 eye, 睛 eyeball; sleep is when the eyes close.
垂 (chuí, droop) hints at the sound and the image: drooping eyelids. Also in 锤 chuí.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — planning is done by talking things through; also 议 discuss, 论 discuss.
某 (mǒu) is a near sound match for móu; same part in 媒 méi and 煤 méi.
礻 (altar, spirit — form of 示) — rites and worship: 神 god, 祝 wish, 福 fortune; 礼 are ritual courtesies.
牛 (ox) — cattle words like 牧 herd and 特 special; 物 first referred to livestock, then to things in general.
勿 (wù) sounds exactly like 物 — handy for recalling the pronunciation.
各 (each) — a foot 夂 arriving at a place 口: each one coming. 各 also sounds out 路 lù, 格 gé, 客 kè and 洛 luò.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 住.
立 (stand) — the spot where a person 亻 stands 立: a position or seat; also 位置 position.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — words and talk: 说, 话, 读; a spoken mistake or misunderstanding.
吴 (wú) gives the sound (wù, tone differs); same series 娱 yú and 虞 yú.
辶 (walk, 走之旁) — movement and roads: 过 pass, 进 enter, 送 send; to follow is to move along behind someone.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do. 便 is a person adjusting things 更 to make them convenient (traditional explanation).
干 (dry; do) — a forked pole or shield. It lends its sound to 肝 gān, 杆 gān, 赶 gǎn, 汗 hàn and 岸 àn.
口 (mouth) — speech sounds and particles: 吧, 呢, 吃; 吗 is the question particle.
马 (mǎ) sounds like 吗 (ma) — same syllable, different tone.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 拉, 抱; here a hand seizing someone to pass judgment.
卩 (kneeling person) — with 又 hand: sentencing a kneeling prisoner, then answering back: repay, report.
力 (lì) sounds exactly like 历 — simplified 历 replaced complex 歷 with 力 for the sound; meaning is passing through time.
由 (from, reason) — mostly useful as a sound part: 油 yóu, 邮 yóu, 柚 yòu, 抽 chōu all contain it.
又 (hand) — a hand holding a branch 十: to prop up, support; 支 also sounds out 枝 zhī branch and 肢 zhī limb.
日 (sun) — sun, light and time: 明 bright, 晴 clear, 时 time; stars are points of light.
生 (shēng) is a loose sound hint for xīng (-ng ending); also in 性 xìng, 姓 xìng.
